jobs.description:
As a UX Design Consultant you will be working on one of our Game Projects in a cross-disciplinary team, taking ownership for UX design of features to improve the end-user experience. You will be part of shipping new features, and balancing maintenance of existing features for live service games.

To thrive in this role we think you have experience working with complex products and designing for different platforms and input methods such as PC, console or mobile.

Start: as soon as possible
Contract: 6 month
Location: Stockholm (onsite)

Example of responsibilities

•

Collaborate across disciplines and align stakeholders to define clear problem statements, user needs and design solutions to solve those.

•

Own the user experience of various features end-to-end, from defining problems and needs iterating all the way until they are in the players’ hands.

•

Design using user flows, wireframes and prototypes, that adhere to the game’s design system and style guides.

•

Work on a range of experiences, from crafting systems to character customization, based on where we can have the biggest impact.

•

Work proactively, identifying gaps in the user experience to inform design decisions

•

Consider systems before individual screens. Consider edge cases early, flexible design solutions, and aim for coherency in design choices.

•

Deliver and explore many possible solutions, while able to narrow down and pivot with relevant feedback.

•

Contribute and foster a culture of sharing and feedback on design.

•

Leverage the team’s combined expertise in finding the best solutions and increase the knowledge across the studio.

We would love if you have

•

A creative and curious mind motivated by understanding user needs and how to fill those to improve the experience.

•

Strong communication skills to clearly convey design decisions, and doing so early and frequently under development.

•

Experience in using both qualitative and quantitative data to understand user needs and finding possible design solutions.

•

Experience with different platforms and input methods, such as focus-based input.

•

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities for the biggest impact.

•

An interest in games and player experiences.

•

4+ years of experience in UX/UI or product design in games.

•

A portfolio with relevant projects showcasing your design process and impact.

•

Knowledge or open to working hands on in game engines

•

Fluency in English.

This is an on-site role, and we are only considering candidates already residing in Sweden.

At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.

Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

Who We Are
At 2K, we build some of the most iconic and culture-shaping video games in entertainment. In 2023, we expanded our publishing arm across 2K Sports Lab, our latest stand-alone studio that is shaping an ambitious plan to redefine the future of sports games. We're currently building a world-class team to build the next iconic sports franchise that’s rooted in bold ideas, innovative experiences and a laser focus on players and fans.

What We Need

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Brand to join our team. This is a critical role that will further develop the foundations of our next blockbuster sports IP, offering a rare opportunity to impact the future of the sports video game category. The role requires strategic leadership, deep cultural understanding, and a clear point-of-view on the sport in service of creating a unique position and voice within the market.

The ideal candidate will be an expert in shaping brand strategy from the ground up, possessing the ability to develop our core audience globally while executing industry-defining creative campaigns. You will lead cross-functional relationships across studio, publishing and geographic boundaries, and will champion the professional growth of your team.

What You Will Do

Brand Strategy

• Franchise Strategy: Shape a comprehensive, long-term brand strategy - refining the franchise's core mission, vision, and positioning - to establish a definitive, authentic foothold in the market.
• Identity, TOV & Behaviours: Establish and champion a global brand identity framework, as well as defining the tone-of-voice and core brand behaviors to ensure a consistent, inspirational, and engaging experience across all player-facing touchpoints.
• Distinctiveness: Establish a clear, authoritative POV on the sport, positioning the franchise uniquely to carve out a distinct space within the always-evolving cultural narrative.

Audience Definition

• Audience Ownership: Partner with the insights team to develop, validate and enrich an evergreen audience segmentation, taking the lead in ensuring all publishing and studio activities orientate around their needs and motivations.
• Internal Advocacy: Inspire and educate the broader organization around our core audience and any adjacent segments, bringing it to life and creating closeness for key functions throughout the business.
• Trend Monitoring: Actively monitor consumer, cultural, and competitor trends to ensure the franchise responds to market shifts at the speed of the audience.

Market Prioritisation

• Priority Market Strategy: Partner with insights and commercial teams to develop and execute a priority market strategy, building, maintaining and circulating a deep understanding of the sport on a global scale.
• Local Market Execution: Oversee the implementation of brand and marketing activities that balance global scale with local nuance, responding dynamically to both global and hyperlocal insights.
• Product Integration: Ensure the product strategy reflects our priority markets, driving integration from deep cultural representation to operational localization to attract players in key territories.

Campaign Development

• Campaign Leadership: Lead all brand-defining campaign development, collaborating with internal creative stakeholders and world class agency partners to deliver industry-defining output.
• Evaluation Frameworks: Define key brand & campaign performance indicators, enabling insights team to build and track success measurement framework.
• Agency Management: A proven track record of managing, briefing, and extracting world-class output from top-tier creative agencies.

Brand Partnerships

• In-Game Integration: Collaborate with the studio and partnership teams to identify and shape authentic brand integrations within the game environment that actively elevate the player experience at both a global and hyperlocal level.
• Marketing Elevation: Shape innovative ways for top-tier brand partners to integrate directly into our marketing plans, supporting the delivery of our core franchise goals.
• Brand Partner Value: Actively participate in meetings with the partnerships team to identify priority partners, build pitch presentations and support ongoing negotiations, developing sophisticated integration frameworks that deliver clear value to all parties.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with a diverse group of internal and third-party stakeholders, leveraging broad perspectives and shared expertise to deliver consistent excellence in execution.
• Feedback & Alignment: Actively engage in and facilitate constructive feedback loops, placing a sharp emphasis on close collaboration with the studio and navigating geographical boundaries within publishing.

Team Leadership

• Line Management: Oversee the direct line management of two individuals, seamlessly shifting between teaching, coaching, and mentoring in support of their continued growth.
• Talent Development: Proactively support the professional growth, skills acquisition, and career development of the broader marketing and commercial team where necessary.

Brand Governance

• Brand Guidelines: Establish, distribute, and enforce global brand guidelines, ensuring all regional marketing teams, licensing partners, and external vendors represent our brand as intended.
• Budget Management: Oversee the overarching brand budget allocation, managing internal and third-party groups to ensure high-quality delivery, financial accountability, and strong ROI.

What Will Make You a Great Fit

• Brand Building Expertise: Proven experience in brand marketing, ideally working on brands that are influential in popular culture.
• Strategic Influence: Highly skilled in aligning diverse stakeholders and drive executive-level decision-making through clear, structured communication and collaboration.
• Global Experience: A truly global career journey, with a deep appreciation for regional differences, cultural nuances, and international market dynamics.
• Growth Mindset: A relentless drive for success, demonstrating a solution-oriented mindset that naturally uncovers opportunities where others see challenges.
• World-Class Communicator: Exceptional communication skills with an innate ability to inspire and engage diverse audiences, while remaining highly receptive to feedback.
• Agile & Adaptable: High operational agility, with the ability to react to both internal and external changes of context at rapid speed.
• Collaborative Team Player: An exceptional team player who thrives on leveraging collective expertise and working cross-functionally across geographic borders.
• Sports & Culture Obsession: A genuine obsession for the sport at both a global and hyperlocal level, with a passion for staying connected to the pulse of the culture.

Bonus Points

• Establishing New IP: Experience working within the pre-production phase of major unannounced entertainment or gaming IP.
• Studio Partnership: Experience collaborating with game developers and studio leadership to translate product features into high-impact cultural narratives.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role:

You want to build and run elegant and thorough machine learning experiments to help us understand and steer the behavior of powerful AI systems. You care about making AI helpful, honest, and harmless, and are interested in the ways that this could be challenging in the context of human-level capabilities. You could describe yourself as both a scientist and an engineer. As a Research Engineer on Alignment Science, you'll contribute to exploratory experimental research on AI safety, with a focus on risks from powerful future systems (like those we would designate as ASL-3 or ASL-4 under our Responsible Scaling Policy), often in collaboration with other teams including Interpretability, Fine-Tuning, and the Frontier Red Team.

Our blog provides an overview of topics that the Alignment Science team is either currently exploring or has previously explored. Our current topics of focus include...

• Scalable Oversight: Developing techniques to keep highly capable models helpful and honest, even as they surpass human-level intelligence in various domains.
• AI Control: Creating methods to ensure advanced AI systems remain safe and harmless in unfamiliar or adversarial scenarios.
• Alignment Stress-testing: Creating model organisms of misalignment to improve our empirical understanding of how alignment failures might arise.
• Automated Alignment Research: Building and aligning a system that can speed up & improve alignment research.
• Alignment Assessments: Understanding and documenting the highest-stakes and most concerning emerging properties of models through pre-deployment alignment and welfare assessments (see our Claude 4 System Card), misalignment-risk safety cases, and coordination with third-party evaluators.
• Safeguards Research: Developing robust defenses against adversarial attacks, comprehensive evaluation frameworks for model safety, and automated systems to detect and mitigate potential risks before deployment.
• Model Welfare: Investigating and addressing potential model welfare, moral status, and related questions. See our program announcement and welfare assessment in the Claude 4 system card for more.

Note: For this role, we conduct all interviews in Python and prefer candidates to be based in the Bay Area.

Representative projects:

• Testing the robustness of our safety techniques by training language models to subvert our safety techniques, and seeing how effective they are at subverting our interventions.
• Run multi-agent reinforcement learning experiments to test out techniques like AI Debate.
• Build tooling to efficiently evaluate the effectiveness of novel LLM-generated jailbreaks.
• Write scripts and prompts to efficiently produce evaluation questions to test models’ reasoning abilities in safety-relevant contexts.
• Contribute ideas, figures, and writing to research papers, blog posts, and talks.
• Run experiments that feed into key AI safety efforts at Anthropic, like the design and implementation of our Responsible Scaling Policy.

You may be a good fit if you:

• Have significant software, ML, or research engineering experience
• Have some experience contributing to empirical AI research projects
• Have some familiarity with technical AI safety research
• Prefer fast-moving collaborative projects to extensive solo efforts
• Pick up slack, even if it goes outside your job description
• Care about the impacts of AI

Strong candidates may also:

• Have experience authoring research papers in machine learning, NLP, or AI safety
• Have experience with LLMs
• Have experience with reinforcement learning
• Have experience with Kubernetes clusters and complex shared codebases

Candidates need not have:

• 100% of the skills needed to perform the job
• Formal certifications or education credentials

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$350,000—$500,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role will require being full-time onsite at our Palo Alto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving.

Crypto is becoming real financial infrastructure and BitGo has spent more than a decade building the products making that transition possible. Since 2013, we’ve built infrastructure that institutions use to custody, trade, stake, settle, and move digital assets. We’ve operated through every market cycle, expanded around the world, earned the trust of thousands of institutions, and become a publicly traded company along the way.

And we’re still early.

We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to help define what comes next: how new products enter the market, how clients understand them, how Sales sells them, and ultimately how BitGo tells its story as digital assets become part of mainstream finance.

This is a role for someone who wants ownership. We’re building at the center of a financial system that is changing in real time, and no two days look the same. You’ll work with the smartest people in the industry to turn complex products and ambitious ideas into simple, compelling stories and bring them to market.

This role is full-time onsite at one of our BitGo hubs. We believe the best GTM work happens when you’re in the room with Product, Sales, and other stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

• Positioning and messaging: Figure out what makes our products matter and develop positioning that is differentiated, memorable, and useful, from the one-sentence pitch to the full product narrative.
• GTM strategy and launches: Own launches alongside Product from idea to adoption. Define the audience and narrative, build the GTM strategy, align teams around it, bring products to market, and keep pushing after launch.
• Competitive and market intelligence: Understand competitors, market structure, client needs, and emerging trends, then turn that intelligence into sharper positioning, better product decisions, and new commercial opportunities.
• Sales enablement: Give Sales the stories and tools they need to win, and turn insights from the field into sharper positioning and GTM.
• Cross-functional leadership: Be the connective tissue between Product, Sales, Marketing, Design, and other teams. Some of the most important opportunities won’t arrive with a perfectly written brief. You’ll turn ambiguity into strategy and strategy into action.
• The BitGo narrative: Help define how BitGo shows up in the world. Partner across Content, Growth, PR, and IR to tell the story of a public company operating at the center of a rapidly changing financial system.

Non-negotiables:

We care more about what you’ve done and how you think than checking every box. But you’ll probably thrive here if you have:

• 4–7 years of product marketing or closely related experience, with meaningful launches you’ve personally driven from strategy through execution, not just supported.
• Exceptional positioning instincts. You can find the simplest, sharpest articulation of why a complicated product matters now.
• A commercial mindset. You care about adoption, revenue, clients, and winning, not just shipping marketing assets.
• High agency. When something is unclear, you investigate. When something is missing, you build it. When something could be better, you say so.
• The ability to cross organizational boundaries and get people moving, even when you don’t formally own the teams involved.
• An AI-forward approach. You already use AI to research, think, write, analyze, and work faster, and you want to push that even further.
• Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly without sacrificing judgment.
• Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn technical products and complex ideas into narratives people immediately understand.

Experience in crypto, fintech, financial services, banking, or high-growth technology is helpful, but not required. Curiosity about how money and markets are changing is.

Why Join BitGo?

There aren't many opportunities to join a company with more than a decade of history that still feels like it's entering its most important chapter.

BitGo is publicly traded, federally chartered, and operates around the world. Our infrastructure sits behind institutions building in digital assets today, and the market we serve is expanding as crypto, stablecoins, tokenization, and traditional financial markets increasingly converge.

That creates an unusual PMM challenge: established company, emerging category, sophisticated customers, complex products, and a lot of white space still left to define. If you want your GTM work to matter at scale and help lead the tradition to the digital asset economy, this is the place to be.

Benefits

• Competitive base salary, bonus, and stock options
• 100% company-paid health insurance for employee, partner, and dependents
• Up to 4% 401k company match
• Paid parental leave, Paid vacation
• Free commuter/parking pass
• Free custom lunches, dinners, and snacks
• Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
• Great colleagues and an inspiring startup environment

Benefits may vary based on location.

Pay Transparency Notice:

Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $130,000 and $150,000 USD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus, and the benefits outlined above are also part of this role’s package.
